authorized_by: TSMOM-DATA-0027 historical USD-M perpetual contract-existence audit
question: Can a daily point-in-time eligible USD-M perpetual universe be constructed from completed official archive data without current-survivor bias, using the project's already-frozen age/liquidity discipline?

data.source: Binance Public Data monthly USD-M 1d kline archives
data.information_timing: daily eligibility at date t uses only the completed t daily kline; any later strategy must execute t -> t+1

eligibility.contract_existence: a valid completed USD-M perpetual 1d archive row exists on date t
eligibility.history_rule: the most recent 240 calendar daily rows through t must all be present; stale cumulative history cannot qualify a relisted/discontinuous contract
eligibility.ordinary_symbol_filter: same stable-base and leveraged-token-like mechanical exclusions used by TSMOM-DATA-0027
eligibility.parameter_source: 240 days and $25m are inherited from the already-frozen PIT-ALPHA/PIT-DISP universe discipline, not selected from TSMOM returns

required_outputs: daily eligible contract count over the full evaluation window
per-symbol first/last data date and first/last eligible date
snapshots of eligible symbols on fixed calendar dates
count of contracts whose archive later ends but which were historically eligible
prohibited: no TSMOM signal or return calculation
no changing 240-day age or $25m liquidity thresholds after observing coverage
no requiring a contract to exist after its historical end date
no filling missing futures data from spot or another venue
next_experiment_rule: Only after this daily PIT universe is frozen may a separate preregistered TSMOM mechanism test reuse the existing 20/60/120/240 time-series trend definition per contract. That first signal experiment must report gross mechanism performance and correlation to BRRK before any portfolio-stack optimization. Funding/cost accounting remains mandatory before promotion.
